shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at −2 on the number line on the left with the mark at 4 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed interval excludes its boundary value −2. Right image: The displayed interval excludes its boundary value 4.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow dot makes equality at −2 inadmissible for the interval. On the right, the hollow dot makes equality at 4 inadmissible for the interval.
